description: Human beings have created and increasingly inhabit a digital world. Our reliance on computers, phones, and digital technology, however, is a recent development. How are our relationships with devices and technology altering us individually? Collectively? Evolutionarily? This seminar will examine the social, psychological, physical, and cultural impacts of computers, internet, smartphones, and AI. We will explore these impacts from different perspectives, including science, social science, and science fiction. Students will reflect on their technology habits, experiment with habit changes, and write a review, an argumentative essay, speculative fiction, and a research project on a topic of their choice.
name: Top: Technology and Humanity
